requirement.applicantContext: Applicants presenting IB qualifications for Doctor of Dental Surgery (DDS) at St Augustine, 2026/27 entry.
requirement.subjectNotes: Pass at least two appropriate Higher Level subjects from IB Groups 4 and 5. Listed subjects are Mathematics, Biology, Physics and Chemistry. Language A (Language A1 before 2013) at grade 4 or higher demonstrates English proficiency.
requirement.conditions: The faculty assesses the stated subjects and English proficiency together with other academic and non-academic criteria. The degree regulations give no overall IB points threshold for this route.

source.title: UWI St Augustine · Faculty of Medical Sciences, 2026/27 handbook · pp. 59
source.evidence: from group 4 and group 5 of the IB
